hook_text: Stand at the southern tip of Africa. Which two hemispheres are you standing in?
clip_script: Cape Agulhas, the southern tip of Africa. Two oceans meet here, the Atlantic and the Indian. Cut the Earth along the equator: Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Cut it along the Greenwich Meridian and the one hundred and eighty degree line: Eastern and Western Hemispheres. South Africa lies south of the equator and east of Greenwich, so it is in the Southern and Eastern Hemispheres. Cape Agulhas: about thirty-five degrees south, twenty degrees east.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of Africa's southern tip with a plaque, then a globe sliced into four hemispheres with South Africa shaded.
mood: Windy and adventurous, like standing at the end of a continent.
pacing: Calm arrival at the tip, then two quick cuts of the globe, ending on South Africa's coordinates.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out which hemispheres your favourite country is in.
